feedback: SQL statement is incomplete and syntactically invalid; missing closing parentheses and final SELECT clause.
CTE "prev" alias is defined but never correctly joined; join to previous lap data is incomplete and uses mismatched aliases.
Join logic incorrectly uses driver_id comparison (a.driver_id < b.driver_id) instead of comparing positions across laps to detect overtakes.
Query does not implement classification of overtakes into retirement, pit‑stop entry, pit‑stop exit, or race start categories.
No aggregation or GROUP BY to count occurrences per category, contrary to the Action Plan step 6.
Missing joins to pit_stops, retirements, or other relevant tables required to determine overtake types.
The SELECT list includes columns unrelated to the required final output and omits required classification fields.
